description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
